explanation: This test only verifies that the FX rate shown matches the rate at initiation, partially covering the 'fx_lock' requirement. It does not test the transactional order of crediting the wallet before debiting the funding source ('credit_before_debit'), nor does it test the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 ('dual_approval'). The test also lacks verification of the actual debit and credit operations and does not simulate or check rollback behavior on callback timeout. It misses asserting that the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited, and that top-ups above the threshold require second-owner approval before settlement.
missingAssertions: Assert that the destination wallet balance increases before the funding source is debited
Assert that for top-ups above SGD 10,000, a second-owner approval is required before settlement
Assert that if the payment provider callback times out after 5 seconds, the transaction is rolled back with no changes to wallet or funding source
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the destination wallet is credited would not be caught, as the test does not verify the order of operations. Also, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 proceed without second-owner approval would be missed.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify transactional integrity and approval workflow for multi-currency wallet top-ups
steps: Initiate a top-up of USD 100 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify that the destination wallet balance increases by the correct amount before the funding source is debited
Verify that the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited
Initiate a top-up above SGD 10,000 (e.g., SGD 15,000)
Verify that the system requires second-owner approval before settlement
Simulate payment provider callback timeout after 5 seconds during a top-up
Verify that the transaction is rolled back and neither wallet nor funding source balances change
Verify that the FX rate used matches the rate locked at initiation
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement; transaction rolls back on payment provider callback timeout
